_comment: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) data inventory (Week 9, Deliverable 4). Covers every data flow in the deployed AfyaPlus path: the triage API, the MCP logistics server, the agent, and the audit trail. lawful_basis values are TEACHING LABELS for this course project - see dpia_stub.md, 'legal review pending'.
owner_of_record: data protection officer - role unfilled, legal review pending
act_reference: Kenya Data Protection Act 2019; compare GDPR (see gdpr_trigger_note.md)

datasets.name: triage_messages
personal_data: symptoms free text (may contain health data - sensitive personal data under s.2 DPA)
datasets.lawful_basis: TEACHING LABEL - health service delivery (compare DPA First Schedule; public health / vital interests reasoning)
datasets.store: API memory / upstream EMR; logs hold redacted+hashed form only
datasets.notes: Health data is sensitive personal data; the DPIA stub treats every triage message as in-scope.

datasets.name: patient_identifiers
datasets.flow: patient_id in requests; actor username in JWT claims
datasets.lawful_basis: TEACHING LABEL - contract / legitimate interest for staff audit identity
datasets.store: JWT (30-min expiry); audit log stores actor_hash only
datasets.notes: No national ID numbers are collected. redact_then_hash.py scrubs NIN-shaped digit runs defensively.

datasets.name: mcp_logistics_queries
datasets.flow: MCP tools: find_clinic_by_county, plan_delivery_route, check_stock; resource clinics://catalog
datasets.lawful_basis: TEACHING LABEL - logistics operations, no personal data in the payload
datasets.store: MCP server logs (tool name + outcome + trace_id only, never raw arguments)
datasets.notes: Clinic phone numbers were removed from tool responses in Week 9 (see mcp_server/server.py PUBLIC_CLINIC_KEYS). Route origins are depot locations, not persons.

datasets.name: audit_logs
datasets.lawful_basis: TEACHING LABEL - legitimate interest: security accountability and incident investigation
datasets.notes: deletion_records.jsonl rows are exempt from sweeping - deleting the record of a deletion defeats the audit (see retention_sweep.py).

cross_border_transfer.note: No data leaves the deployment host. If a cloud model backend is ever enabled, this row must be re-assessed before enabling (DPA transfer rules; compare GDPR Chapter V).

rights_paths: rights_lookup.py (access/erasure stub against a static fixture; owner named in manager_brief.md)
